functions.contract: 分配DateComponentsFormatter，依次设置includesApproximationPhrase=false、maximumUnitCount=1、unitsStyle=abbreviated，写入共享槽；Void返回。
按year、month、day、hour、minute、second顺序返回首个非nil且>0的Calendar单位；均无正值返回nil。
三种日期模式：named按reference系统本地化；abbreviated按Calendar.current从date到reference算六单位，选首正单位，formatter结果nil或无单位回退named；absolute用medium日期/short时间。

initialization: Three optional shared formatter slots; independent static once tokens invoke Void initializers that construct/configure/write their slots.
limitations: Only these five methods. Header compact producer, date-label refresh timer, parent VM and generated ABI are not promoted.
